reason: Cline preparation blocked: Issue #1646 ('[每日信息流] 2025-04-15', label 'daily') is an auto-generated daily security-news digest, not a code change request. The repository's own .github/workflows/daily.yml runs 'gh issue create --title "[每日信息流] `date +'%Y-%m-%d'`" -F today.md --label "daily"' on a cron schedule; issue #1646 matches that exact title/label/body template and its body is only a checklist of external news links (butian.net, xz.aliyun.com, 4hou.com, reddit, etc.). There is no reproducible defect, no engineering feature, and no focused code-level maintenance ask. The admission's technical_signals (bug, bug_bounty, bypass, errors) are keyword false-positives harvested from headlines such as the vulnerability-bounty-researcher article and the MCP security checklist; the $10,000 figure has no funding artifact beyond the issue URL itself and the issue has zero comments. Repository is not withdrawn (master live at cabf4e9, 2026-10-30) and two unrelated open PRs (#2617, #2335) exist, but neither competes with nor makes this a code task. Per classification rules this is a documentation/content artifact without a repository change, so no checkout was modified and no branch/PR was produced.
